xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: Note 1 - Multiwyn Investments and Holdings Pvt Ltd is holding 21.93%, i.e., more than 20% shares in the Company and thus the same is mentioned as Promoter. Note 2 - In the SBO Sheet, in Sr. No. 3, details of the Direct holding are shown of Mr. Hemant Kumar Ruia, Mrs. Shalini Ruia and Mr. Yashvardhan Ruia, who are holding together and collectively and exercising right in the Amines & Plasticizers Ltd., which amounts to 42.01% of the paid-up share capital of the Company. The same is also mentioned in the Shareholding Pattern under Table II - Statement showing shareholding pattern of the Promoter and Promoter Group under Serial No A (1)(a) under the category of Individuals/Hindu Undivided Family. Note 3- Entities and individuals forming part of "Promoter(s) & Promoter(s) Group including Minors" but holding NIL shares as on September 30, 2026 have also been included in Table II. Note 4- Master Reyaansh Ruia and Master Ruvvir Ruia are minor sons of Mr. Yashvardhan Ruia (Promoter). Note 5 - As per the data provided by the RTA, there were 4 Nos. of LLP who are holdings 22049 shares in the Company were categorised as “Body Corporate” instead of LLP because as per the DP Database their category shows as “Bodies Corporate” and accordingly RTA had classified them as Body Corporate. The Company was told that the said classification is pursuant to the applicable SEBI circular/guidelines on the System Driven Disclosures (SDD), based on the data received from NSDL and CDSL. However, on the back up data verification, the Company found that although DP database of abovementioned 4 Nos. of LLP reflects them as “Other Body Corporate” instead of LLP, but their name are suffixed with word “LLP” and also 4th letter of their Permanent Account Number (PAN) is “F” which refers to LLP (the Partnership Firm cannot hold shares in their own name) and therefore as a principle of transparency, accuracy, reliability and authenticity of data to be shared with Stock Exchanges, the Company deemed appropriate to classify them as LLP only basis on the PAN verification as well as name suffixed with word LLP.
